BEP 19: HTTP/FTP Seeding (GetRight-style).

Supports downloading pieces from HTTP/FTP URLs specified in the torrent. We implement BEP 19 (GetRight) style: url-list in metainfo, HTTP range requests.

API: httpRangeRequest(url, start, end) — one-shot range fetch (opens + closes connection) openWebSeedConn(url) / fetchRange(conn, ...) / close(conn) — persistent connection
